title: i built an mcp that gets playtesters for your game
author: Unique-Watercress225
selftext:
it's been wonderful seeing all the great games getting made here. as a solo dev you can build so much faster now, but playtesting hasn't sped up at all. that step still needs humans (unfortunately), and the existing options are either expensive playtesting platforms or friends who just say "looks cool."

so I built an MCP that lets your Claude call for playtesters where you can just get playtesters by prompting.

repo: [https://github.com/alex-durango/pingfusi](https://github.com/alex-durango/pingfusi)

and it's open source too, if you want to just use it with your friends.

comments.author: -svde-
comments.body:
where do the actual play testers come from? you say pickup happens in a manne of minutes - do you have an entire testing team on standby? and since it’s billed per minute of play time, do you have any tracking diagnostics set up to ensure your testers are actually playing fully? are they required to record their play footage? that would be highly beneficial to the paying dev customer. 

it’s an interesting idea but pretty vague as to how it works on that end

replies.author: Unique-Watercress225
replies.body:
Thanks for the questions! We’re still in alpha, so the testers are currently me and a group of my friends. We usually begin testing as soon as a request comes in.

Yes, we can record the gameplay and send you the raw video. This gives you an exact timestamped record of how long the playthrough took and helps you see how a new player approaches the game.

We’d be happy to run a free playtest for you so you can try it out and see whether it’s valuable.

replies.author: ReefSharksixty9
replies.body: Me and my friends? Idk man.

replies.author: Unique-Watercress225
replies.body: can you tell me what gives you a pause?
